law.catch_line: Penalty for filing complaint or cooperating in investigation prohibited

text.section: An official, the Department, a local department, a child-serving agency, a children's residential facility, or a child-placing agency shall not penalize any person for filing a complaint or cooperating with the Ombudsman in investigating a complaint.

An individual, the Department, a local department, a child-serving agency, a children's residential facility, or a child-placing agency shall not hinder the lawful actions of the Ombudsman or employees of the Ombudsman.
A report by the Ombudsman is not subject to prior approval by a person outside of the Office.
